name: Alessandro Finocchiaro
bio: My Android story began with a green UI and a gingerbread man: Gingerbread. I’ve been writing Android code since before Fragments existed. From there, I’ve ridden every wave of innovation: from the rigidity of Eclipse to the power of Gradle, from the verbosity of Java to the elegance of Kotlin. Today, I bring this unique perspective into the new era of mobile development, building bridges between platforms with Kotlin Multiplatform..
